pillar_reactions.evidence: He supplied his own objection and the rep mapped it straight onto the modality — 'What I don't like is training core separately. I like to have core integrated in whatever I do' answered with 'with kettlebells, everything that you just said is interesting because... your core is every single movement.' He then volunteered alignment on the mobility half unprompted: 'Yeah, the imbalance, yeah... I do mobility twice a week, too.'

The rep half-conceded the pillar before presenting it — 'Cool. Nutrition's handled' and later 'Sounds like your nutrition is pretty good, but you still want to dial it in' — and the prospect agreed without questions. Notably he never asked how an animal-protein-led philosophy applies to a lentil-based vegetarian diet, and the rep never volunteered it beyond one clause.

He pushed back on the substance of the pillar when invited to: 'I think educating is more important for me instead of the accountability part because I don't mind putting in the work as long as I learn something new from it.' The rep had pre-empted it ('You don't strike me as the kind of guy who's like watches Netflix instead of trains') and then still presented 24/7 support as an accountability mechanism rather than as an education one.

anchors.raw: It is definitely above budget for sure.
anchors.note: An explicit budget ceiling stated the moment the number landed, from a prospect who otherwise raised no doubt about the product. He also named the mechanism — 'the amount that I need to put aside for this would be considerable' — which is a liquidity constraint, exactly the one the payment plan exists to solve. It was never quantified.

anchors.raw: the six months is eight thousand three hundred canadian and the 12 months is twelve thousand five hundred canadian... the exact number canadian for six months is eight thousand two hundred and ninety one canadian
anchors.note: The figure that landed is CAD 8,291, not 6,000, and the rep quoted it twice, once rounded up and once exactly, before mentioning the USD equivalent. This is the second Canadian prospect in the batch to have the price anchored roughly a third higher by conversion, and there is no CAD price list to reference.

anchors.raw: I just practice calisthenics and yeah, so handstand push-ups and all of that
anchors.note: A free, self-programmed practice that has previously taken him to 60 kg weighted dips for sets of five. He already owns a kettlebell. The zero-cost alternative is credible and was never contrasted — the rep instead affirmed his competence repeatedly ('you're already in a better spot than most people'), which strengthens rather than weakens the anchor.

anchors.raw: given the fact that I'm getting what I'm getting is something to consider
anchors.note: He rated the offer worth considering despite exceeding budget, which means the value case landed and only the funding question is open. That is the exact condition the open-wallet play is written for.

unmet_demand.want: A vegetarian, lentil-and-Indian-diet-based nutrition protocol that supports serious muscle gain
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Answered with a single clause — 'making sure that we're taking account for the vegetarian as well' — with no protocol, no protein strategy and no example client. The same rep describes the nutrition philosophy elsewhere as 'a lot of protein, red meat, eggs, chicken, dairy' and 'if it doesn't come from an animal or come from the ground, we don't eat it', so whether the programme genuinely serves a vegetarian bulking goal is unproven either way.

unmet_demand.want: To keep his weighted calisthenics — weighted pull-ups and dips — alongside kettlebell work
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep described his own personal hybrid split in detail and said 'a lot of the stuff that we do is both as well', but never confirmed whether the tailored programme would actually include loaded calisthenics or whether the six-month kettlebell guarantee constrains what else can be programmed.

unmet_demand.want: Explosive fast-twitch development and sport-specific endurance for soccer
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Asserted rather than demonstrated — 'It's a lot of fast twitch, a lot of core' and 'you get a fighter physique'. No mechanism, progression or evidence was offered for the athletic-performance goal that was the prospect's first-stated objective.

unmet_demand.want: Pricing he can plan against in his own currency
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Converted live on the call to two different Canadian figures within a minute, then split into two CAD instalments improvised on the spot. There is no published local pricing and no written terms were sent.
